verdict.rationale: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator built for scripted runs. Its CI-friendly signals include non-interactive invocation (`yy pi --no-session`), CI-meaningful exit codes (`doctor workspace` intentionally exits nonzero), and JSON watch receipts with state and exit_code fields. It also offers reusable YAML workflows and run-until-completion and parallel-runner scripts that emit structured evidence. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions or another CI pipeline), a documented headless or non-interactive auth/config mode, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
